statement: Brent crude front-month futures settle above 120.00 USD per barrel on any trading day between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: Any front-month Brent settlement above 120.00 USD in the window, per ICE settlement data or two financial wire services. Intraday highs do not count.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury yield closes above 5.00 percent on any trading day between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: Any daily close at or above 5.00 percent on the benchmark 10-year yield per US Treasury par yield curve or two financial wire services.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite closes below 22478 on any trading day between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: Any official Nasdaq Composite daily close below 22478, which is ten percent below the 24975.82 reference close in this report, per exchange data.

statement: German authorities announce the arrest or formal charging of a suspect in the Berlin Pride vehicle attack between 2026-07-26 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: German police or prosecutors publicly confirm an arrest or charge tied to the Berlin Pride ramming, reported by two independent wire services in the window.

statement: A NATO member formally requests Article 4 consultations over Russian drone or airspace incursions between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: NATO or a member government confirms an Article 4 request citing Russian drone or airspace incursion, per NATO statement or two independent wire services.

statement: Syria and Israel sign or jointly announce a concluded security agreement between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: Both governments confirm a concluded security agreement, not talks or a framework, per official statements or two independent wire services in the window.

statement: A supply-chain compromise affecting 100 or more packages on npm, PyPI, or a GitHub-hosted registry is publicly disclosed between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: A registry operator or established security vendor reports a single campaign compromising 100 or more distinct packages, with a named incident writeup in the window.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 4.5 or greater occurs within 100 km of Spearman, Texas between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: USGS catalogs an event of magnitude 4.5 or greater with an epicenter within 100 km of Spearman, Texas in the window.

statement: French authorities order a mandatory evacuation of any arrondissement inside Bordeaux city proper due to wildfire between 2026-07-26 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A prefectural or municipal mandatory evacuation order covering territory inside Bordeaux commune boundaries, attributed to wildfire, per two independent wire services.

statement: The Democratic Party wins control of the US House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm election, as called by the Associated Press by 2027-01-15.
resolution: The Associated Press calls Democratic control of the House with at least 218 seats on or before 2027-01-15.
